name: minutes_since_open
definition: k = number of completed regular-session 1-minute bars so far (k=1 at 09:31 ET). Decision time t is the end of bar k. On early-close days the session end comes from the calendar, not from a fixed 16:00. [catalog S4]
inputs: exchange calendar: session open and close
needs: NYSE calendar (Alpaca market calendar/clock endpoint or a local calendar). No market data.
lookahead_risks: None if session open/close come from the calendar (half-days, DST). Do not hard-code 390 minutes.

name: session_phase
definition: Category from k: open_drive (k<=30), morning (31-120), midday (121-270), afternoon (271-360), close (361-390); bucket edges scale on half-days. Edges are our parameters, not evidence. [catalog S4, E2]
lookahead_risks: None. Bucket edges are arbitrary; changing them counts as a new trial (MT-G7).

name: event_risk_today
definition: Highest impact class (NONE/MEDIUM/HIGH) among scheduled events dated today in a calendar built before the session, plus minutes_to_next_event and minutes_since_last_event. Unknown coverage is treated as BLOCK, not as 'no event'. [catalog S1]
inputs: official calendars: Federal Reserve FOMC, BLS CPI/jobs, BEA GDP/PCE, others; repo file lab/scalp/live/events_2026.json
needs: Official free web calendars (Fed FOMC and BLS CPI dates were verified in this research; other releases need checking). Not Alpaca market data.
lookahead_risks: Use the calendar as it stood before the session. Unscheduled events (speeches, geopolitics) are absent. Dates can move. Impact classes are a judgment call.

name: megacap_earnings_flag
definition: 1 if any of the top-10 weights of SPY/QQQ reports after yesterday's close or before today's open (2 if after today's close). [catalog S2]
needs: External earnings calendar (company investor-relations pages or a vendor). Not on Alpaca.
lookahead_risks: Use only dates and before-open/after-close timing announced before the session; estimated dates are not confirmed dates.

name: expiry_calendar_flags
definition: Integers/booleans: is_monthly_opex (third Friday, or the prior trading day if a holiday), is_quarterly_opex (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec), days_to_month_end, is_half_day, is_day_before_holiday. [catalog S3]
needs: Calendar only (Alpaca calendar endpoint or local).
lookahead_risks: None. Rebalance dates and VIX-expiry weekday were not verified; do not add them without a source.

name: daily_trend_state
definition: Score -2..+2 = sign(C_prev - SMA50_prev) + sign(SMA50_prev - SMA200_prev), from completed daily bars up to yesterday. [catalog C1, C4, A1]
needs: Alpaca daily bars, SIP history since 2016 (free when older than 15 minutes).
lookahead_risks: Exclude today's forming daily bar. Keep raw versus dividend-adjusted series consistent. SMA200 needs 200 completed daily bars.

name: price_vs_daily_ma_atr
definition: (P_t - SMA20_daily_prev) / ATR14_daily_prev, where P_t is the last completed 1-minute close and the daily values are as of yesterday. [catalog C3, K1]
lookahead_risks: Daily inputs must end yesterday. Live P_t comes from IEX bars and may differ slightly from SIP history.

name: weekly_trend_state
definition: Score -2..+2 = sign(C_w - SMA10_w) + sign(SMA10_w - SMA30_w) from the last completed weekly bar (built from daily bars; a holiday week ends on its last trading day). [catalog A1, C4]
needs: Alpaca daily bars since 2016; 30 weekly bars need about 30 weeks of history.
lookahead_risks: Never use the current week's forming bar. Week boundaries with holidays are a common bug.

name: ema_stack_5m
definition: (EMA9>EMA20) + (EMA20>EMA50) - (EMA9<EMA20) - (EMA20<EMA50) on completed 5-minute closes; range -2..+2. EMAs use alpha=2/(n+1), SMA-seeded, warmed up over at least 250 5-minute bars including prior sessions. [catalog C1]
needs: Alpaca 1-minute bars aggregated to 5 minutes (IEX live, SIP history).
lookahead_risks: Exclude the forming 5m bar. Overnight gaps sit inside the warm-up. Live IEX bars are not identical to SIP bars (small price differences).

name: ema20_slope_5m_atr
definition: (EMA20_t - EMA20_(t-6 bars)) / (6 x ATR14_5m) on completed 5m bars: slope in ATR per bar. |slope|<0.02 treated as flat (our parameter). [catalog C2]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only; slope thresholds are parameters.

name: mtf_alignment_score
definition: Mean over frames {weekly, daily, 60m, 15m, 5m} of sign(last completed close - EMA20), each frame from its own last CLOSED bar; range -1..+1. Weekly and daily are as of the prior session. [catalog A1]
needs: Alpaca daily and 1-minute bars aggregated by us.
lookahead_risks: Classic bug: using the forming higher-timeframe bar. Frames are built from the same prices, so agreement is not independent confirmation.

name: swing_structure_5m
definition: From the last two CONFIRMED fractal swing highs and lows (N=3 bars on each side) on 5m bars: +1 if higher high and higher low, -1 if lower high and lower low, 0 otherwise; also bars_since_last_confirmation. A swing at bar j is confirmed only when bar j+3 has completed. [catalog B1, B2]
lookahead_risks: Swing at bar j is known only after bar j+N: store confirmed_at and never use it earlier. Libraries that look N bars forward leak the future.

name: break_of_structure_5m
definition: +1 if the last completed 5m CLOSE is above the most recent confirmed swing high, -1 if below the most recent confirmed swing low, else 0; change_of_character=1 on the first break against the prior trend. [catalog B3]
lookahead_risks: Use closes, not the forming bar's wick; use only confirmed swings. Educators define BOS/CHoCH differently.

name: adx_di
definition: Wilder ADX(14), +DI and -DI on completed 5m bars and on daily bars (prior session); outputs ADX and sign(+DI - -DI). [catalog J4]
lookahead_risks: Wilder smoothing needs about 150 bars to settle; warm up. Completed bars only.

name: regression_trend_30m
definition: OLS slope (per minute, divided by ATR14_1m) and R-squared of the last 30 completed 1-minute closes. [catalog B4]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. Slope over a short window is noisy.

name: vwap_distance_atr
definition: VWAP_t = sum(TP_i x v_i) / sum(v_i) over completed bars since 09:30, TP=(h+l+c)/3; feature = (P_t - VWAP_t) / ATR14_5m. [catalog D1]
needs: Alpaca 1-minute bars. Volume-based: live IEX volume is about 2.5% of SIP volume, so it is not the same measurement as the SIP backtest.
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. Feed mismatch (MT-G35): compute on the same feed for backtest and live, or keep shadow-only. Few data points early in the day.

name: vwap_sigma_z
definition: sigma_t^2 = sum(v_i x (TP_i - VWAP_t)^2) / sum(v_i); z_t = (P_t - VWAP_t) / sigma_t; undefined before 15 completed minutes. [catalog D2]
lookahead_risks: Running sums must not include the forming bar. sigma definition differs between vendors; ours is volume-weighted about the current VWAP.

name: vwap_side_streak_and_crosses
definition: Signed count of consecutive completed 1-minute closes on the same side of VWAP (positive above), and the number of side changes since 09:30 (a chop measure). [catalog D1]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. High cross counts mean a range day; the cost of trading flips is large.

name: anchored_vwap_prior_day_extremes
definition: AVWAP anchored at the START of the minute bar that made yesterday's regular-session low, and another at the high: sum from anchor to t of TP x v over sum of v; feature = (P_t - AVWAP)/ATR14_5m for each. [catalog D3]
lookahead_risks: Anchors are yesterday's, already complete. Do not anchor at today's swing before it is confirmed (hindsight). Anchor rule is a design choice.

name: rvol_5m_time_of_day
definition: Sum of volume over the last 5 completed 1m bars divided by the mean of the same 5 minute-of-day slots' sums over the previous 20 sessions (baseline excludes today; missing minutes count as 0). [catalog E1, E2]
needs: Alpaca 1-minute bars; a minute with no eligible trade has no bar.
lookahead_risks: Baseline must exclude today and use the same feed. Alpaca emits no bar for empty minutes; treat consistently. Early closes and opex days distort baselines.

name: rvol_cumulative_time_of_day
definition: Cumulative volume since the open divided by the mean cumulative volume at the same minute over the previous 20 sessions. [catalog E2]
lookahead_risks: Exclude today from its own baseline; align by minutes since open (half-days differ).

name: volume_climax_flag
definition: 1 if z_vol >= 3 and the last completed 5m bar's range >= 2 x ATR14_5m, where z_vol=(vol - mean20)/sd20 for the same time slot over 20 sessions; also returns the bar's CLV=((c-l)-(h-c))/(h-l). [catalog E1, E4]
lookahead_risks: Completed bar only. Thresholds are ours. 'Climax' is judged with hindsight in books; here it is only a flag.

name: updown_volume_ratio_30m
definition: Sum of volume of up bars (c>o) divided by sum of volume of down bars (c<o) over the last 30 completed 1m bars; a bar-colour stand-in for delta. [catalog E3, P3]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. Bar colour is a crude proxy for who was aggressive.

name: signed_volume_tick_rule_30m
definition: Sum over trades in the last 30 completed minutes of size x sign, sign=+1 if price > previous trade price, -1 if lower, carry the previous sign if equal (tick rule). [catalog P1, P3]
needs: Alpaca trades: SIP history (free after 15 minutes); live free trades are IEX only.
lookahead_risks: Use trades with timestamps before t only. Exclude conditions that do not update price. IEX prints are a small biased sample; tick rule misclassifies many trades.

name: prior_day_levels_distance
definition: Signed distances (P_t - PDH), (P_t - PDL), (P_t - PDC) in ATR14_daily_prev units, plus a location code: above PDH / inside / below PDL. PDC=closing-auction price when available. [catalog F1]
needs: Alpaca daily/minute bars and the historical auctions endpoint (SIP only).
lookahead_risks: Levels come from the previous regular session only. Daily bars and minute bars follow different update rules in Alpaca (odd lots, extended hours); take all levels from one source.

name: gap_open_atr
definition: gap = official_open_today - official_close_prev (auction prices); gap_pct = gap/close_prev; gap_atr = gap/ATR14_daily_prev; fixed once at 09:31. [catalog G1]
needs: Alpaca historical auctions (SIP only) for research; live fallback is the first regular trade.
lookahead_risks: The first 1-minute bar's open is not the official opening-cross price. Never use the day's high or low to describe the gap.

name: gap_fill_fraction
definition: For a gap up: (open - min low so far)/(open - close_prev), capped at 1; mirrored for gap down; 0 when no gap; filled=1 when price has traded at close_prev. [catalog G2]
lookahead_risks: Uses lows so far only. 'All gaps get filled' is false for breakaway/runaway gaps (StockCharts).

name: premarket_range_position
definition: (P_t - PML)/(PMH - PML), PMH/PML=max/min price 04:00-09:29 ET from SIP extended-hours data; plus (PMH-PML)/ATR14_daily_prev. Undefined if the range is zero. [catalog F2]
needs: Alpaca SIP history with extended hours. Live free IEX trades only from 08:00 ET, so the live value is not comparable.
lookahead_risks: Minutes without eligible trades have no bars. Feed coverage differs (04:00 versus 08:00). Compute on SIP for backtests and flag the feed.

name: opening_range_state
definition: For n in {5,15,30}: after the n-th minute completes, ORH/ORL=max high/min low of bars 09:30..09:30+n; state=+1 above ORH, -1 below ORL, else 0; distance to the nearer edge in ATR14_5m; width/ATR14_daily_prev. [catalog F3, R4]
lookahead_risks: Undefined until the window has closed. IEX extremes can differ slightly from SIP extremes.

name: weekly_levels_distance
definition: Distances in ATR14_daily_prev units from P_t to the prior week's high and low and to this week's high and low so far. [catalog F4]
lookahead_risks: Prior week only from completed days; this week's extremes use days already closed plus today's so-far values.

name: round_number_distance
definition: Distance in ATR14_5m units from P_t to the nearest multiple of $5 and of $10, using RAW (unadjusted) prices. R=5 and 10 are our choice. [catalog F5]
needs: Alpaca bars requested with raw (unadjusted) prices.
lookahead_risks: Dividend-adjusted series shift historical levels, and the adjustment factor depends on later events. Use raw prices for this feature only.

name: pivot_points_daily
definition: P=(H+L+C)/3 of the prior day; R1=2P-L, S1=2P-H, R2=P+(H-L), S2=P-(H-L); features: signed distance to P and to the nearest of R1/R2/S1/S2 in ATR units. Numeric formulas are standard but were not verified in the source text. [catalog F6]
lookahead_risks: Prior period only. Levels are static all day.

name: prior_day_value_area
definition: From yesterday's regular-session 1m bars: allocate each bar's volume at its typical price into $0.05 bins; POC=max bin; VAH/VAL=smallest contiguous range around POC holding 70% of volume, grown one bin at a time toward the larger neighbour; features: open location (inside/above/below) and distance of P_t to POC/VAH/VAL in ATR. Bin size and allocation rule are our choices. [catalog E5, F8]
needs: Alpaca SIP 1-minute bars (trade-level data is better).
lookahead_risks: Only yesterday's completed profile. Do not build 'today's' profile from bars after t. Bin size and volume allocation change POC.

name: bar_shape_5m
definition: For the last completed 5m bar: body/range, upper_shadow/range, lower_shadow/range, CLV=((c-l)-(h-c))/(h-l), inside_bar, outside_bar; plus signed run length of same-colour 5m bars and run displacement in ATR14_5m. Raw metrics, not named patterns. [catalog H1, H2]
lookahead_risks: Completed bar only. Candle shape depends on the data source (IEX-only bars differ from SIP bars); named patterns multiply trials.

name: rsi14
definition: Wilder RSI(14): first averages are simple means of 14 gains/losses, then avg=(prev x 13 + current)/14; RSI=100-100/(1+AvgGain/AvgLoss); on completed 5m bars and on daily bars (prior session). [catalog J1]
lookahead_risks: Values depend on history length; warm up at least 250 bars. Completed bars only.

name: macd_hist_5m
definition: MACD=EMA12(c)-EMA26(c); signal=EMA9(MACD); histogram=MACD-signal, and its 1-bar change, on completed 5m closes. [catalog J2]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only; warm up over prior sessions.

name: stochastic_14_3_3_5m
definition: %K=(close - LL14)/(HH14 - LL14) x 100, smoothed once with a 3-bar SMA; %D=3-bar SMA of that (slow 14,3,3) on completed 5m bars. [catalog J3]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only.

name: return_30m_z
definition: (P_t - P_(t-30min)) / (sigma_1m x sqrt(30)), where sigma_1m is the standard deviation of 1-minute returns at the same time slots over the previous 20 sessions (excludes today). [catalog K6]
lookahead_risks: Baseline excludes today. Missing minutes must be handled the same way live and in history.

name: atr14_multi
definition: Wilder ATR(14) on 1m and 5m (completed bars) and on daily bars (prior session); also ATR as a percent of price. TR=max(h-l,|h-prev c|,|l-prev c|). [catalog K1]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. Daily ATR must end yesterday.

name: realized_vol_ratio
definition: RV60=sqrt(sum of squared 1-minute log returns over the last 60 completed minutes); ratio to the median RV60 at the same time of day over the previous 20 sessions. [catalog K6]
lookahead_risks: Baseline excludes today. Bid-ask bounce inflates 1-minute RV; keep the same feed.

name: bollinger_pctb_bandwidth_5m
definition: middle=SMA20(c), bands=middle +/- 2 x SD20(c); %b=(c-lower)/(upper-lower); BandWidth=(upper-lower)/middle x 100; plus BandWidth percentile over the last 120 bars; completed 5m bars. [catalog K2]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. Bollinger's own rule: a band tag is not a signal.

name: squeeze_state_5m
definition: on = BB(20,2) upper < KC upper and BB lower > KC lower with KC = EMA20 +/- 1.5 x ATR20; also bars_in_squeeze and just_fired (turned off on the last completed bar). Keltner variants differ; this is ours. [catalog K3, K4]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. State carries no direction. Variant choice changes the signal count.

name: nr7_inside_day_prior
definition: NR7=1 if the prior day's range is smaller than each of the 6 days before it; NR4 likewise with 3 days; inside_day=1 if the prior high <= the day-before high and the prior low >= the day-before low. [catalog K5]
lookahead_risks: Prior completed day only. Use one range definition (absolute range, as Crabel did).

name: day_range_used
definition: (HOD - LOD) so far divided by ATR14_daily_prev; and, when VIX1D is available, divided by open x VIX1D/sqrt(252)/100 (approximate expected move). [catalog K6, M2]
needs: Alpaca bars; VIX1D is not on Alpaca.
lookahead_risks: HOD/LOD so far only. The VIX1D part is optional and needs an outside source.

name: initial_balance_state
definition: After 10:30 ET: IB=high/low of bars 09:30-10:29; IB width/ATR14_daily_prev; extension_up=max(0,HOD-IBH)/IB width and extension_down likewise; state in {inside, ext_up, ext_down, both}. Before 10:30 only the developing IB is reported. Thresholds are ours. [catalog E6, R1]
lookahead_risks: Do not label the FINAL day type (trend, neutral...) as an input; it is known only at the close. Only IB width, open location and extension so far are causal.

name: advance_decline_proxy
definition: Among N index constituents (S&P 500 preferred, point-in-time list): 100 x (count(last price > prior close) - count(last price < prior close)) / N; also coverage = share of names with a trade in the last 2 minutes. PROXY for NYSE ADD. [catalog L2]
inputs: snapshots: latest trade, previous daily close, for ~500 symbols
needs: Alpaca multi-symbol snapshots (latest trade and previous daily bar); free IEX live; 200 REST calls a minute.
lookahead_risks: Point-in-time constituents avoid survivorship bias. IEX last trades can be stale for quiet names: skip stale ones and report coverage.

name: tick_proxy_1m
definition: Among constituents: count(last completed 1m close > previous 1m close) - count(<), divided by N. PROXY for NYSE TICK; not the same measurement. [catalog L1]
needs: Alpaca 1-minute bars for constituents (SIP history; live IEX bars are sparse for quiet names).
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only. Real $TICK is trade-by-trade; this is a bar-level stand-in and will differ.

name: pct_above_vwap_proxy
definition: Share of constituents whose last completed 1m close is above their own session VWAP. Practitioner extension, no source verified. [catalog L5]
lookahead_risks: Own-VWAP uses completed bars only; feed mismatch for volume; survivorship if the list is today's.

name: ad_volume_trin_proxy
definition: adv/dec = count up / count down versus prior close; advvol/decvol = volume of advancing constituents / volume of declining ones; TRIN_proxy=(adv/dec)/(advvol/decvol). [catalog L3, L4]
lookahead_risks: Ratios blow up when a denominator is near zero: cap them. Feed mismatch for volume.

name: sector_leadership
definition: For the 11 Select Sector SPDR ETFs: return since open minus SPY's return since open; outputs: rank per sector, mean of top 3 minus mean of bottom 3, and risk_on_spread = mean(XLK,XLY,XLC) - mean(XLU,XLP,XLV) (our grouping). [catalog O2]
inputs: 1m or latest-trade prices for 11 sector ETFs and SPY
needs: Alpaca bars/snapshots. 12 symbols fit inside the free 30-symbol WebSocket limit.
lookahead_risks: Since-open returns use the first regular trade; IEX prints can be sparse in small ETFs. Sector weights are dominated by a few stocks.

name: qqq_spy_relative_strength
definition: RS=QQQ/SPY (price relative); outputs: return of RS since open, slope over the last 30 completed minutes in bps per minute, and RS versus its 20-day mean. [catalog O1]
lookahead_risks: Completed bars only; both series aligned on the same timestamps.

name: vix_daily_context
definition: Prior-day VIX close, its 1-day change, its 252-day percentile, and expected daily move VIX/sqrt(252) percent (rough). [catalog M1]
needs: Not on Alpaca. VIX daily close is on FRED (series VIXCLS, verified) and on Cboe pages; license terms not checked.
lookahead_risks: VIX is disseminated until 16:15 ET, after the equity close, and FRED posts it later; use only the PRIOR day's value. Never use today's final VIX before it exists.

name: vix1d_and_term_structure
definition: VIX1D/VIX ratio (intraday, from 09:31 ET), VIX3M/VIX - 1 and VIX9D versus VIX (daily). [catalog M2, M3]
needs: Not on Alpaca. Cboe publishes the indices (methodology verified); data access route not verified.
lookahead_risks: VIX1D history begins in 2022 (launched 24 April 2023). Use values as of t only. VIX1D changes mechanically as the day passes.

name: cross_asset_etf_proxies
definition: Return since open of TLT (rates; price moves opposite to yields), UUP (dollar), USO (oil), GLD, and HYG minus IEF (credit); risk_on flag when SPY up, TLT down and HYG-IEF up. ETF tickers are standard; not each verified. [catalog N2-N5]
inputs: latest trade or 1m close for ETFs
lookahead_risks: Sparse IEX prints: use the last trade not older than 2 minutes or skip. Correlations flip between regimes.

name: futures_overnight_change
definition: ES and NQ futures change from the prior cash close to 09:29 ET; premium to fair value. [catalog N1] Proxy on our data: F28.
needs: Not on Alpaca (no futures endpoints in its documentation index).
lookahead_risks: Use futures values at or before t. Cash-close alignment and carry adjustments.

name: spread_and_quote_imbalance
definition: Quoted spread in bps of the midpoint, and top-of-book size imbalance (bid_size - ask_size)/(bid_size + ask_size) from the latest quote. IEX top of book is not the national best bid and offer. [catalog P2]
inputs: latest quote: bid, ask, sizes, timestamp
needs: Alpaca latest quotes (IEX live). SIP quote history free after 15 minutes.
lookahead_risks: Use the last quote with a timestamp at or before t; drop stale or crossed quotes. IEX-only quotes are wider than the NBBO.

name: option_open_interest_walls
definition: For SPY/QQQ options expiring today, the next weekly and the next monthly: strike with the largest call OI above spot, the largest put OI below spot, total call and put OI within +/-3% of spot, and distance of P_t to each strike in ATR14_5m. [catalog Q5]
inputs: option contracts: strike, expiration, type, open_interest, open_interest_date
needs: Alpaca option contracts endpoint (open_interest, open_interest_date; free). It returns only current OI: save a snapshot every day to build history.
lookahead_risks: OI is published once a day: use the value dated before today. Same-day 0DTE trades are not in OI.

name: gex_proxy_and_flip
definition: Per-strike dollar GEX = gamma x OI x 100 x S^2 x 0.01, with calls positive and puts negative (a convention, not data); summed; flip level = spot at which the recomputed total crosses zero. Gamma from our own Black-Scholes using mid-quote IV, because Alpaca omits Greeks for 0DTE. [catalog Q6]
needs: Alpaca option chain snapshots (indicative feed: quotes not actual OPRA, trades delayed 15 minutes) and contract OI.
lookahead_risks: OI from before today; IV from the indicative feed is unreliable when bid/ask are wide; sign convention is the model. Vendors disagree. Shadow-only.

name: options_sentiment_daily
definition: Prior-day Cboe total/index/equity put-call ratios, SKEW index (100 - 10 x S), and SPX 0DTE share of SPX volume. [catalog M4, Q4, Q7]
needs: Not on Alpaca. Cboe statistics pages; terms of use and download route not verified.
lookahead_risks: Publication lag: use the prior day's value only. Definitions and exchange coverage change over time.
